title: Cognition OS
tagline: Brain science turned into small experiments you can try today, scored like a game.
stateNote: Live, with a free tier. The full course is unlocked with a license key.
problem: Most advice about focus and decisions is either vague or buried in videos. Cognition OS turns it into lessons, habits and tools you try in the browser.
audience: Students and anyone who wants to think more clearly.
contribution: It is my project, built with React and TypeScript. The source is private.
worksToday: 26 lessons, 17 habits and 6 thinking tools, as listed on the site.
Progress stays in your browser; no sign-up is needed for the free part.
A Brain Power calculator you can try on the home page.
limitations: The Brain Power numbers are the site's own cautious estimates, not medical advice.
Most lessons need a paid license.
